items.prompt: Hyper-realistic vertical full body of a girl at a car show, captured with a Canon EOS R5 and an 85mm f/1.4 lens, emphasizing a distinctively dewy, glass-skin complexion. The subject is an white female with dark hair and a luminous, highly hydrated skin texture that catches the ambient convention lighting; specular highlights glisten naturally across her cheekbones, the bridge of her nose, and forehead, showcasing a premium, moisture-rich skincare finish without appearing oily. She holds a playful, dynamic pose, leaning slightly against the side of a modified white sports car, her body angled to display the vehicle’s livery. Her right arm extends forward, index finger pointing directly into the camera lens, creating a foreshortened perspective where the fingertip is slightly soft due to shallow depth of field, while focus remains razor-sharp on her eyes and face. She is winking her right eye while her left eye remains wide and engaging, featuring a sharp, dark pupil with distinct catchlights from overhead softboxes. Her expression is a confident, welcoming smile with gradient pink lips that have a moisturizing gloss finish. Her hair is long dark hair, long, and pulled back into a high ponytail that cascades over her right shoulder. She wears a tight-fitting black racing romper with a red-tabbed zipper at the chest; the text "FORTEC" is printed in white and red on the left chest and right thigh. A subtle dusting of freckles just below the eyes is visible on her left collarbone, and she wears a thin gold necklace. On her legs, she wears black thigh-high suede boots with heels, her right leg bent at the knee in a classic Reference image women stance. To her left, the car door and fender are visible, painted white with gold racing graphics. The lighting is bright, diffused, and cool-toned, typical of a convention hall, creating smooth transitions between light and shadow on her skin and the car's metal surfaces. The background is pushed into a creamy, indistinct bokeh, revealing blurred shapes of exhibition booths and signage, ensuring the subject pops against the busy environment. High-fidelity texture rendering captures the weave of the fabric, the velvet texture of the boots, the sleek gloss of the car paint, and the ultra-smooth, dewy quality of her skin.

Each section of the house, from the cross-sectional view of the walls to the individual bricks in the chimney, is meticulously detailed and labeled. The background is a stylized parchment, evoking the sense of traditional architectural plans. Text annotations are included to describe materials, construction techniques, and dimensions. The lighting is warm and soft, suggesting a sunset ambiance. The blueprint is created with fine digital lines and a watercolor effect to blend the charm of old-world craftsmanship with modern design clarity.
